title: Saudi Arabian Peas Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic Middle Eastern-inspired pilaf dish made with saudi rice, peas, and spices.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the rice and stir to coat with oil and mix with the onion.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
Stir in the peas, salt, black pepper, and pilaf spice mix.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the peas are heated through.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
